title: Law to tighten ban on unsafe menstrual and intimate care products
summary: This bill clarifies the city's prohibition on selling or distributing menstrual and intimate care products containing harmful ingredients such as lead, formaldehyde, talc, certain phthalates and fragrance. It requires the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to maintain a public list of products containing these restricted substances and updates how the department sets safety thresholds. Violations carry a civil penalty of up to $250 per violation, and the law takes effect 90 days after becoming law.
